_comment: Conditional post-action checklists. Items never complete themselves: every status must be entered by the user, and 'Not applicable' requires a reason. Deadlines are not calculated because no reviewed deadline rule exists.

items.requirement: Inform the person promptly of the reasons for the arrest
items.quote: to be informed promptly of the reasons therefor;

items.requirement: Inform the person of the right to retain and instruct counsel without delay
items.quote: to retain and instruct counsel without delay and to be informed of that right; and

items.requirement: Young person: advise without delay of the right to counsel and give an opportunity to obtain counsel
items.applicability: Person is a young person under the YCJA
items.quote: be given an opportunity to obtain counsel

items.requirement: Young person detained in custody pending appearance: notice to a parent
items.applicability: Young person detained in custody pending appearance (subject to s. 26(4))
items.quote: notice of the arrest stating the place of detention and the reason for the arrest

items.requirement: Consider release under s. 498(1) where it applies
items.applicability: Arrest without warrant, offence not listed in s. 469, not otherwise released or taken before a justice
items.quote: a peace officer shall, as soon as practicable, release the person, if

items.requirement: If not released, cause the person to be taken before a justice as set out in s. 503(1)
items.quote: cause the person to be taken before a justice to be dealt with according to law

items.requirement: Arrest by a person other than a peace officer: deliver the person to a peace officer forthwith
items.applicability: Arrest made under s. 494 by a non-peace officer
items.quote: shall forthwith deliver the person to a peace officer

entries.title: Attempting to collect identifying information (O. Reg. 400/23)

items.requirement: Confirm the attempt is not prohibited by s. 6 (racialized-group and arbitrariness limits)
items.quote: A police officer shall not attempt to collect identifying information about an individual from the individual if,

items.requirement: Inform the individual they are not required to provide identifying information (unless s. 7(2) applies)
items.quote: has informed the individual that the individual is not required to provide identifying information to the officer; and

items.requirement: Inform the individual why (unless s. 7(2) or (3) applies)
items.quote: has informed the individual why the officer is attempting to collect identifying information about the individual.

items.requirement: Offer the document recording the attempt, and give it if wanted (unless s. 8(2) applies)
items.quote: offer to give the individual a document that provides a record of the attempt; and

items.requirement: Record the information required by s. 9
items.quote: shall record the following:

items.requirement: Record the grounds for believing the person is acting or has acted in a disorderly manner
items.quote: is acting or has acted in a disorderly manner

items.requirement: Record which of clauses (a)–(c) and which of (d)–(f) apply, with facts
items.quote: has reasonable cause to believe that the person,

items.requirement: Record why it would be dangerous to proceed under s. 16
items.quote: that it would be dangerous to proceed under section 16

items.requirement: Remain at the facility and retain custody until the facility takes custody
items.applicability: Custody taken to a psychiatric facility
items.quote: shall remain at the facility and retain custody of the person until the facility takes custody of him or her in the prescribed manner

citations.excerpt_contains: Duty to remain and retain custody

entries.title: Before taking a statement from a young person (YCJA s. 146)

items.requirement: Clearly explain the matters in s. 146(2)(b)(i)–(iv) in language appropriate to age and understanding
items.applicability: Young person under 18, circumstances in s. 146(2)
items.quote: clearly explained to the young person, in language appropriate to his or her age and understanding, that

items.requirement: Give a reasonable opportunity to consult counsel and a parent or other appropriate adult
items.quote: been given a reasonable opportunity to consult

items.requirement: If a person was consulted, give a reasonable opportunity to make the statement in that person's presence
items.quote: the young person has been given a reasonable opportunity to make the statement in the presence of that person

items.requirement: Any waiver of s. 146(2)(c) or (d) is recorded on video/audio tape or in a signed written statement
items.quote: must be in writing and contain a statement signed by the young person that he or she has been informed of the right being waived
